messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: high memory usage on pool-gpu-3 (node-17) — OOM kills observed, CUDA driver errors in last 10m. Pager routed to #eng-oncall.

sara: seeing lots of container restarts on node-17, 5xx spike ~12% for /v1/generate on models/redwood-7b-quant. Memory keeps drifting up even after evictions.

miguel: grabbing logs now. getting repeated `CUBLAS_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED` and `OOM when allocating tensor` across paged-attn allocator.

kelly: is this the same slow-creep fragmentation we've seen before or a sudden leak?

miguel: looks like slow creep. KV cache free lists are fragmenting, available free bytes drop while total allocs remain high. sample from dmesg:

```
[2026-03-15T02:12:06Z] runtime: GPU memory alloc failed: 0x7f.. : CUBLAS_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED
[2026-03-15T02:12:07Z] container restart: /srv/runner (exit 137)
[2026-03-15T02:12:10Z] paged-alloc: slab 0x2f3a: large free-run gaps -> fragmentation 82%
```

kelly: any customer-facing impact?

sara: yes — two enterprise tenants (org-phi, org-nimbus) reported timeouts. Dashboard shows latency tail rising: p95 doubled, errors up from 0.4% to 8% in region-us-west-2.

david: tagging oncall-rotation @here — please ack and start mitigation plan.

oncall-rotation: acked. I'm taking lead for live mitigation.

opsbot: NOTE: autoscaler attempted to drain node-17 at 02:14 but pod evictions failed due to large mem footprints -> scaled up pool-gpu-3 by 1 node at 02:16.

rohit-sre: quick triage: this smells like paged-attn allocator fragmentation + slowdown in background compaction. Proposed short-term mitigations: (1) force KV cache compaction on affected nodes, (2) raise eviction aggressiveness for paged-kv on that pool, (3) route traffic away from node-17 via smart-routing to healthy variants.

miguel: I can run compact on node-17 but it will cause short CPU spike and temporary latency blips. prefer doing compaction one node at a time.

sara: let's do this in steps:
- step A: enable routing policy to route 30% away from pool-gpu-3 to pool-gpu-5 for canary traffic.
- step B: trigger `kv-compact --target=slab --node=node-17` with 1 node at a time.
- step C: temporarily lower `paged_kv_threshold` from 0.6 -> 0.45 to force earlier eviction.

kelly: sounds good. who runs A?

oncall-rotation: I'll flip the routing rule now.

--- (a few minutes later) ---

oncall-rotation: routing change applied: pool-gpu-3 traffic down 40% to pool-gpu-5. Observed drop in 5xxs from 8% -> 5% so far.

miguel: starting kv compaction on node-17 now: `ssh node-17 sudo /usr/local/bin/kv-compact --slab --background=false`

miguel: compaction log snippet:
```
compaction: slab 0x2f3a -> compacting 94MB
compaction: freed 72MB, fragmentation -> 14%
compaction: completed 02:26:11
```

miguel: node-17 mem dropped ~60MB post-compact. still tracking.

kelly: after compaction did we see any crash loops stop?

miguel: container restarts reduced. one crash during compaction window (OOM on helper process). overall stability improving.

rohit-sre: good. next: we should adjust `paged_kv_threshold` cluster-wide for 1h window and monitor. I'll push a temporary config via ops control plane: `PATCH /config/policies` body -> `{ "paged_kv_threshold": 0.45 }`

opsbot: CONFIG PATCH submitted by rohit-sre at 02:34:11. change will rollout to pool-gpu-* over 30s.

sara: customer comms: org-phi SLOs impacted. I pinged AE and solutions-eng; opened ticket INC-7192 with details and mitigation steps.

kelly: any node flaps left?

miguel: node-19 showing signs of the same pattern. scheduling compaction there next.

sara: for the on-call handoff — summarize actions and owner:
- routing adjusted -> oncall-rotation (done)
- node-17 compaction -> miguel (done)
- node-19 compaction -> miguel (in progress)
- temporary threshold change -> rohit-sre (done)
- customer comms -> sara (ongoing)
- postmortem owner -> kelly (assign to write-up)

oncall-rotation: leaving this in the thread for next shift. current status: incident mitigation in progress, partial recovery, customers partially impacted.

david: please capture metrics and attach graphs to INC-7192: mem-usage, fragmentation ratio, restarts, 5xx rate by org.

miguel: compaction on node-19 completed at 02:48:52. fragmentation down to 18%. memory regressions slowed but not eliminated.

kelly: we should consider emergency hotfix: background slab defrag worker that runs incremental compaction during low traffic, and a fast-path to evict oldest KV segments when fragmentation crosses 80%. Proposal for immediate PR: `runtime: add incremental_slab_defrag` with config knobs.

rohit-sre: agree. also want to add a safeguard: if paged allocator fragmentation > 85% for >5m, auto-drain node via scheduler to prevent customer impact. I'll file SRE action item.

sara: customer note drafted and sent to affected AEs. org-phi reported reduced errors after 02:40, still seeing occasional timeouts. org-nimbus requested dedicated mitigation - we're engaging solutions-eng.

oncall-rotation: final handoff note for next oncall: monitor fragmentation metric `paged_kv.fragmentation` and `paged_kv.free_runs` for pool-gpu-*, keep routing policy toggled until 02:00 UTC if stable, escalate to rohit-sre if 5xxs climb >5% for more than 10 minutes.

kelly: assigning postmortem to me, will collect timeline and owners. initial severity: Sev2.

rohit-sre: follow-ups (short list):
- implement incremental slab defrag (engineer + test)
- auto-drain threshold rule in scheduler
- add metric alert for slow memory drift (trend-based)
- improve compaction to be less disruptive

miguel: I'll draft the PR for compaction improvements and add a safe-mode flag.

sara: thanks everyone for fast triage. will update INC-7192 with timeline + customer updates.

incident-bot: Incident status changed: Mitigated -> Partial Recovery at 02:54. Next update scheduled in 2h or on new trigger.

rohit-sre: marking follow-up meeting for long-term mitigation planning tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

oncall-rotation: handing off to next oncall; keep this thread pinned for continuity.

kelly: please include snippet of compaction logs in the postmortem and tag engaged engineers.

sara: noted. closing loop for now, will reopen if metrics regress. :thumbsup:
